Name: Medieval Unicorn by Nighty
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
Unicorn skin tested on Adopt and Skin mod

To use it just download the zipped file, unzip it, take the png file you want to use, go to the "assets" folder of the Adopt and Skin mod, then go to "skins" and create a folder there named "Horse" and just drop or copy/paste your unicorn skin there and rename it "Horse_1" to replace your horse's skin with the unicorn one.

Should work with other mods but not tested yet.

Downloads.Description: This is a version of my medieval unicorn you can use with the Alternative textures mod, thanks to CosmicLunaria who converted it!
